title: West side of Main Street burns 1980
description: This photograph offers another view of the aftermath of the July 15, 1907 fire, highlighting the destruction of the east side of the Hartland Bridge ramp and toll house. The blaze not only devastated the west side of Main Street’s commercial area in 1907, but the very same area, rebuilt by local businesses, was destroyed again in 1980.
